title: heterotoma cordifolia var. intermedia
intro: Heterotoma cordifolia var. intermedia, commonly known as Heartleaf, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Heartleaf include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. It is used therapeutically for its expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, helping to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Heartleaf include volatile oils, flavonoids, and saponins, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
